messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Into to R classes?
parts:
Hi All,

Without trying to shamelessly self-promote, I offer an intro R course “Data science for Biologists” through CBS that will be given the number BIS 15L. Currently, it is under BIS 098 but has made it most of the way through new course approval. 

I emphasize that it is introductory and has a focus on a variety of data types used by biologists. I suspect that it would set folks up well for more in-depth courses. Please feel free to email if you would like the CRN or have questions. Last year it was run through the FRS series and was a lot of fun. 

You can see last year’s curriculum here:
https://jmledford3115.github.io/datascibiol/

Sincerely,
Joel Ledford
